# equate

> Tools for matching things: featurize, compare, and match collections of objects (fuzzy correspondence, not exact equality).


## Pages

- [equate](index.html.md): Match things that have no shared identifier: names with typos, product listings from two shops, reco...
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;equate&#96;   | Tools for matching things: featurize, compare, and match collections of objects.   |
- [equate](_autosummary/equate.html.md): Tools for matching things: featurize, compare, and match collections of objects.
- [equate.base](_autosummary/equate.base.html.md): Foundational contracts and data structures for equate.
- [equate.block](_autosummary/equate.block.html.md): The block stage (② scalability): candidate generation.
- [equate.block.metablock](_autosummary/equate.block.metablock.html.md): Meta-blocking (stage ②): refine a candidate set to raise precision without losing
- [equate.block.ann](_autosummary/equate.block.ann.html.md): ANN / dense-vector blocking: candidate generation by nearest-neighbour search.
- [equate.block.keyed](_autosummary/equate.block.keyed.html.md): Keyed blocking (stage ② scalability): emit candidate pairs that share a blocking key.
- [equate.block.lsh](_autosummary/equate.block.lsh.html.md): MinHash-LSH blocking for set/token (Jaccard) similarity — requires &#96;equate&#91;lsh&#93;&#96;
- [equate.block.metrics](_autosummary/equate.block.metrics.html.md): Blocking evaluation metrics (stage ②): quantify the recall/efficiency trade-off of a
- [equate.block.score](_autosummary/equate.block.score.html.md): Score only the blocker’s candidate pairs into a sparse ScoreMatrix (decision D1).
- [equate.cluster](_autosummary/equate.cluster.html.md): The resolve/cluster stage (③ grouping): turn pairwise matches into entity groups.
- [equate.cluster.classify](_autosummary/equate.cluster.classify.html.md): Classification (the optional decide stage): map a comparison score to a decision.
- [equate.compare](_autosummary/equate.compare.html.md): The compare stage (②): score how alike two (featurized) items are.
- [equate.compare.calibrate](_autosummary/equate.compare.calibrate.html.md): Score calibration (stage ②): map raw comparator scores to a decision or a
- [equate.compare.numeric_geo](_autosummary/equate.compare.numeric_geo.html.md): Numeric, date, and geospatial comparators (stage ②): turn a domain distance into a
- [equate.compare.sequence](_autosummary/equate.compare.sequence.html.md): Sequence-alignment comparators (stage ②): score two &#42;sequences&#42; by aligning them.
- [equate.compare.sets](_autosummary/equate.compare.sets.html.md): Set comparators: how much two &#42;value sets&#42; overlap (stage ②, for columns and bags).
- [equate.compare.string](_autosummary/equate.compare.string.html.md): String comparators (stage ②): pairwise similarity between two strings.
- [equate.compare.vector](_autosummary/equate.compare.vector.html.md): Vector comparators (stage ②): pairwise similarity/distance between two vectors.
- [equate.compare.vectorize](_autosummary/equate.compare.vectorize.html.md): Multi-field record comparison (stage ②): build a per-pair &#42;comparison vector&#42; from
- [equate.completion](_autosummary/equate.completion.html.md): Tabular completion: find join keys, near-duplicate columns, and fill a table from another.
- [equate.evaluate](_autosummary/equate.evaluate.html.md): Evaluate matchers honestly: metrics, leakage-aware splits, and a benchmark harness.
- [equate.evaluate.suites](_autosummary/equate.evaluate.suites.html.md): Loaders for the standard matching benchmarks, fetched on first use into a store.
- [equate.evaluate.benchmark](_autosummary/equate.evaluate.benchmark.html.md): Self-benchmarking: a benchmark registry and an honest-by-default harness.
- [equate.evaluate.difficulty](_autosummary/equate.evaluate.difficulty.html.md): How hard is a benchmark? A measured difficulty profile to print next to a score.
- [equate.evaluate.labels](_autosummary/equate.evaluate.labels.html.md): Convert between the two granularities: pairs and cluster labels.
- [equate.evaluate.metrics](_autosummary/equate.evaluate.metrics.html.md): Pairwise and cluster-level match metrics, dependency-light.
- [equate.evaluate.ranking](_autosummary/equate.evaluate.ranking.html.md): Threshold-free and ranking metrics, and threshold selection as its own step.
- [equate.evaluate.scores](_autosummary/equate.evaluate.scores.html.md): The one score type every metric returns: precision and recall, never F1 alone.
- [equate.evaluate.split](_autosummary/equate.evaluate.split.html.md): Leakage-aware splitting: split over entities, so test entities are unseen.
- [equate.evaluate.store](_autosummary/equate.evaluate.store.html.md): Where downloaded benchmark data lives: a store (a &#96;MutableMapping&#96;), never the package.
- [equate.facade](_autosummary/equate.facade.html.md): The equate facade: the one-line &#96;match(A, B)&#96; entry point.
- [equate.featurize](_autosummary/equate.featurize.html.md): The featurize stage (①): map objects to comparable representations.
- [equate.featurize.columns](_autosummary/equate.featurize.columns.html.md): Column featurizers: a column (a sequence of cell values) as a comparable object.
- [equate.featurize.graph](_autosummary/equate.featurize.graph.html.md): Graph featurizers (stage ①): turn whole graphs into vectors (graph kernels).
- [equate.featurize.records](_autosummary/equate.featurize.records.html.md): The text of an object, for text featurizers: a record (mapping) is its joined values.
- [equate.featurize.text](_autosummary/equate.featurize.text.html.md): Dense text-embedding featurizers, behind optional extras.
- [equate.featurize.tfidf](_autosummary/equate.featurize.tfidf.html.md): Pure-numpy/scipy character-n-gram TF-IDF — equate’s zero-heavy-dependency default
- [equate.interactive](_autosummary/equate.interactive.html.md): The interactive stage: human-in-the-loop review and re-optimization.
- [equate.interactive.candidate_store](_autosummary/equate.interactive.candidate_store.html.md): The CandidateStore: per left-item top-k candidates with scores — the SSOT for review
- [equate.interactive.constraints](_autosummary/equate.interactive.constraints.html.md): Interactive constraints and re-optimization: every user edit is a constraint, not a
- [equate.interactive.kbest](_autosummary/equate.interactive.kbest.html.md): k-best assignments via Murty’s algorithm (in-house; pure numpy/scipy).
- [equate.interactive.review](_autosummary/equate.interactive.review.html.md): Human review triage and active-learning query selection.
- [equate.matching](_autosummary/equate.matching.html.md): The match stage (③): turn a score matrix into a correspondence.
- [equate.matching.assign](_autosummary/equate.matching.assign.html.md): Assignment matchers (stage ③): turn a score matrix into matched &#96;(i, j)&#96; pairs.
- [equate.matching.embedding_align](_autosummary/equate.matching.embedding_align.html.md): Embedding-based network alignment: embed both graphs’ nodes, then match the embeddings.
- [equate.matching.quadratic](_autosummary/equate.matching.quadratic.html.md): Quadratic matchers: align the &#42;nodes&#42; of two graphs (network alignment).
- [equate.matching.soft](_autosummary/equate.matching.soft.html.md): Soft / optimal-transport matching (stage ③): a fractional transport plan rather than a
- [equate.registry](_autosummary/equate.registry.html.md): A tiny name-keyed strategy registry with lazy factories (open-closed dispatch).
- [equate.service](_autosummary/equate.service.html.md): The service layer: equate’s matching core as JSON-in/JSON-out operations.
- [equate.util](_autosummary/equate.util.html.md): Utils for equate.
